hypotheses.reasoning: auth-svc's outbound calls to the identity provider (idp.example/oauth2/token) start failing at 23:49:15 with HTTP 401 'invalid API key'. Repeats at 23:50:35, 23:51:28 and 23:52:18 say the key is 'invalid or revoked' / 'credentials not accepted'. Before this, auth-svc was healthy (POST /tokens ok, line 2887 at 23:49:03). The only earlier IdP error was a transient connection reset that recovered on retry (#477, #480), and the IdP status feed (#1831) shows an incident in sa-east-1 that does not cover us-east-1, so it is not the cause. The 401s point to a credential problem: the API key was revoked, expired, or rotated without the service being updated. account-svc then gets 502 from auth-svc (#3066, #3429), and edge-proxy returns 502 on POST /login (#2915, #3076). Those 502s are downstream symptoms and are not cited as evidence of the fault. The legacy-inventory healthcheck timeouts in status-poller (#1012, #1403, #1744) are unrelated noise.

verdict.recommendedAction: Check the IdP API key used by auth-svc (verify whether it was revoked or rotated at about 23:49 UTC on 2026-10-01). Deploy a valid key via the secret/config source and restart or reload auth-svc. Confirm that POST https://idp.example/oauth2/token returns 200 and that the edge-proxy 502 rate drops. Separately, clean up the deprecated legacy-inventory healthcheck in status-poller.
